hypothesis: The champion aux10 are boosted trees (lgbm/xgb/cat). Genuinely distinct classical inductive biases -- bagged/random forest (ExtraTrees, RandomForest), oblique/rotated splits, additive logistic, and RBF kernel -- may decorrelate from the boosted-tree portfolio while staying competitive. Fold-0 discovery screen decides whether any merits full 5-fold OOF.
why_distinct: Bagged forests randomize split CANDIDATES + thresholds (vs boosting's sequential focus); oblique forest splits on projections (vs axis-aligned); kernel ridge is a nonparametric smoother. These differ from both the boosted-tree aux10 and the neural/FLM blocks already tested.
view: full (certified rich 285-feature view via ViewBuilder.assemble; fold-safe TE fit on FIT, EVAL labels never read). route (22-feat) offered as an apples-to-apples secondary.
protocol: train on FIT (folds 1-4), inner 10% ES split fold-safe from FIT, predict fold-0; scaler (where used) fit on FIT-train only; champion hash-asserted via load_champion_fold0.
screen_metrics_bar: promising if portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND logit_pearson_vs_portfolio < 0.995 (fold-0 discovery proxy; cannot pass admission gate)

oblique.recipe: Gaussian random projection -> ExtraTrees (cheap oblique/rotated-split proxy)

kernelridge.recipe: RBF KernelRidge on StandardScaler, FIT subsampled to 40k (O(n^2))

negative_rule: record NEGATIVE for the exact frozen recipe + protocol; do not rerun identically. If all classical candidates sit at port_delta < +5e-5 with corr ~0.99 (redundant with the boosted-tree aux10), close the classical-member path: bagged/oblique/kernel biases do not decorrelate enough to add an 11th member.
anti_leakage: view assembled fold-safe (TE fit on FIT only, EVAL labels never read); model fit on FIT only; inner ES split fold-safe; no target encoding beyond the certified fold-safe TE blocks; champion loaded from hash-asserted phase17 artifacts.

budget.note: all CPU; runs parallel to GPU jobs
